studio.title: Studio
studio.aboutQuote: We are a global studio for sustainable architecture, urbanism, engineering and design, founded by Norman Foster in 1967.
studio.aboutText: Foster + Partners is a global studio for sustainable architecture, urbanism, engineering and design, founded by Norman Foster in 1967. With offices across the world, the practice works as a single entity that is both ethnically and culturally diverse, with people central to all our endeavours.

descriptions.aboutDesc: From the very beginning our practice was founded on a philosophy of innovation, sustainability and design. We continue to learn from the past and creatively embrace the challenges of the future, with a firm belief that good design makes a difference.
descriptions.lifeDesc: Foster + Partners welcomes designers, innovators, makers and pioneering trailblazers. We nurture innovation and flexibility to deliver extraordinary projects.
descriptions.vacanciesDesc: We want to work with the best talent from across the industry and develop our people to grow within our practice.
descriptions.ediDesc: We are committed to equity, diversity and inclusion across our practice. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our design and our culture.
descriptions.csrDesc: Our corporate social responsibility extends to the communities we work in, the environment we shape, and the legacy we leave for future generations.
descriptions.globalDesc: With studios around the world, we deliver projects locally while drawing on our global expertise and collaborative networks.

descriptions.architectureDesc: From the very beginning our practice was founded on a philosophy of innovation, sustainability and design. We continue to learn from the past and creatively embrace the challenges of the future, with a firm belief that good design makes a difference.
descriptions.climateDesc: Sustainability has been a central theme of our work for more than five decades. We work closely with our clients to develop bespoke design solutions that are optimised for their operations and the planet.
descriptions.engineeringDesc: Our integrated engineering teams deliver structural, mechanical, electrical and environmental solutions that push the boundaries of what is possible in building performance and efficiency.
descriptions.technologyDesc: We invest in research and development to pioneer new materials, construction methods and digital tools that shape the future of architecture and urban design.
descriptions.interiorsDesc: Our interior design practice creates spaces that enhance human experience, combining functionality with aesthetic excellence across workplaces, hospitality and cultural venues.
descriptions.urbanDesc: We design urban landscapes and master plans that respond to local context, climate and community needs, creating resilient and liveable cities for future generations.
descriptions.workplaceDesc: Our workplace consultancy helps organisations reimagine their environments to support collaboration, wellbeing and productivity in an evolving world of work.
descriptions.masterPlanningDesc: We develop comprehensive master plans that integrate architecture, infrastructure and landscape into cohesive, sustainable urban frameworks.
